purpose: Acquire missing factual player counters and complete goal/commentary evidence; no target-assist rules or rescoring.
source: Public ESPN eng.1 scoreboard by fixture date and event-scoped summary; exact response bytes retained.
development: Leicester-Everton and Norwich-Arsenal, 2019-12-01, inspected only for source schema before control selection.
selection: All current missing_data penalty_goals/fouls_won fixtures. Controls: first three closed-ledger positive penalty fixtures and first three fully closed all-zero penalty fixtures in each of 2019-20, 2020-21, 2022-23, 2024-25 and 2025-26; disjoint from targets. Freeze plan before fetching controls. For 2025-26, where penalty_goals is not a requirement, use archived explicit attPenGoal positives and the first three other source fixtures.
identity: Unique date/home/away identity, exact final scores, completed FT. Unique native roster name match within actual historical club, reciprocal athlete matching, globally consistent season/player code versus ESPN athlete ID. Unknown/ambiguous identities abstain.
fouls_won: Use only explicit finite nonnegative integer foulsSuffered from an explicit one-appearance roster record. Never use omitted values as zero.
penalty_goals: Require unique complete non-shootout scoring-event inventory equal to final scores, recognized goal/goal-header/own-goal or exact id98 penalty---scored type, all scorer identities, and each participant's goal and own-goal counts equal native FPL. Count exact id98 events per scorer; zero requires the complete inventory. Unknown goal types, cancelled/incomplete events or conflicting score/scorer vectors abstain for the fixture.

validation.all: Freeze predictions before comparing closed-ledger outcomes; compare all available closed values in fetched fixtures, including protected values outside planned controls. Any conflict blocks the field globally. Report shared-source/previously observed regression limits and retain collective quality flags. This is an additional source-specific qualification, not a replacement or reduction of prior gates. Penalty control references also include explicit archived attPenGoal and native FPL goals_scored=0 subset bounds; these are reported separately. An omitted source penalty counter for a goal scorer is never zero.

application: Only absent missing_data penalty_goals/fouls_won fields. Preserve every other ledger cell and all raw/native fields, approved values, locked scoring and models. Acquire commentary/key events for later use without treating provider goalAssists as target-rule assists.
